comment: M59: the upgrade reference worlds of this branch are built, not stored. smoketestUpgrade (and runServer -PsmoketestOldWorld) build a missing one in the saves folder of the run with tools/upgrade/<script> from the commit named here (build_reference.sh: that commit's buildShowcase plus the old-side class 'class' of tools/upgrade, default DevUpgradeReference; chain.sh: the world 'from' opened and saved by that commit). 'default' is the world -PsmoketestOldWorld and the tour use; 'suite' are the worlds smoketestUpgrade loads one after another without -PupgradeWorld (M68: the 1.13.1 reference and the M67 world with the old pipe system).
